lead: brief lead 1 -- Triton unified/gluon decode paged attention vs the aiter MFMA kernel
how: SGLANG_USE_AITER_UNIFIED_ATTN=1, restart-paired, analysis/decode_probe_ab.sh, off-contract probe load (analysis/probe_load.py --n 192 --conc 64 --osl 1024)
verdict: rejected -- 6.33x slower decode, 4.86x slower wall. Not a marginal call; campaign stopped after one paired round.
cause: aiter_backend.py:938-955 builds the unified path's page table as torch.zeros(bs, max_kv_len) with page_size 1, i.e. one block per KV token, so the Triton kernel runs one block iteration per token instead of per 16/64. --page-size 1 is a sealed launch argument, so this path cannot be rescued within the contract.
engagement_evidence: prefill throughput is unchanged (+0.18%) while decode collapses, which localises the change to the decode branch and rules out a whole-server confound.
